title: OpenCode unit tests require optional CLI installed
outcome: The full Rust gate fails 25 otherwise in-memory OpenCode/ACP tests when the developer machine lacks the optional opencode executable. Session setup calls production PATH readiness even though test AppState disables runtime spawning and tests use in-memory ACP handles. Make test builds hermetic for OpenCode setup while preserving production readiness validation and dedicated readiness-resolution tests; rerun the complete Rust wrapper.
disposal_reason: Backlog triage w-930e4d333f07 (Architect1 batch 1a, spot-checked by Termal::Fable2): CLOSE-DONE. The injected readiness resolver is present (src/agent_readiness.rs:16-17, collect_agent_readiness_with) on master f7db2c58. Closed by evidence.
